name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 26, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Nerice Kaufman, Member of Soroptimist International of Vista
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of Fair Housing Poster Contest Awards
P2.
Proclamation declaring April 10 - 16, 2011, Public Works Week in the City of Vista
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Appointment of Notaries Public to Act for and on Behalf of the City (CC)
C4.
Collection of Delinquent FY 2010/2011 Property-Related Administrative Citations (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , declaring its intent to set a public hearing for collection of delinquent property-related administrative citation charges; and
2.
Set June 14, 2011, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2011/12 property tax roll for collection of delinquent property-related administrative citations.
C5.
Collection of Delinquent FY 2010/2011 Mandatory Trash Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , declaring its intent to set a public hearing for collection of delinquent solid waste charges; and
2.
Set June 14, 2011, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2011/12 property tax roll for collection of delinquent mandatory trash charges.
C6.
Engineer’s Reports and Assessments for FY 2011/2012 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista Lighting and Landscaping District No. 1 assessments for the 2011/12 Fiscal Year and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , determining the cost of services and the amount of assessment to be imposed on all assessable property within the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2011/12 pursuant to the Benefit Assessment Act of 1982; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District assessments for the 2011/12 Fiscal Year and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments.
C7.
School Resource Officers (CC)
C8.
Morris B. Vance Community Room Kitchen Cleaning Fee (CC)
C9.
Waiver of Site Rental Fees for Brengle Terrace Park Easter Egg Hunt (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
